At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Alliance sympathizer [[Bon Seqours]] carried out a spectacular '''heist''' at the [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Randar Dowellin]]. During the heist, Sequours and at least one accomplice stole Dowellin's private [[Collector/Legends|collection]] of unique [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] artifacts.<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|The Farrimmer Cafe}}</ref>
